_comment: Joint declarations for check_collisions.py and motion_sweep.py. Part names are matched case-insensitively as substrings of each STL's basename, so 'bearing_608' matches 'build/bearing_608.stl'. Delete this _comment and replace the examples. The older bare-list form (contacts only, no motion) is still accepted.

contacts._comment: Declaring a pair licenses the interference you state -- not any interference. An overlap outside the range fails, and so does a declared press fit whose parts do not touch. Declared pairs are also exempt from the motion sweep, since they are meant to stay in contact. A pair within range is ALSO required to touch in exactly one contiguous region by default -- a legitimate contact plus an unrelated structural collision can otherwise hide behind the same declared range (INCIDENTS.md, 2026-08-19). Add "multi_region_ok": true only for a joint that genuinely touches in several places on purpose (e.g. a splined shaft).

motion._comment: 'ratio' is this part's motion per unit of the sweep parameter. Meshing external gears turn OPPOSITE ways, so one ratio is negative -- getting that sign wrong is the easy mistake and produces a sweep that proves nothing. Give 'teeth' on every revolute driver and the sweep collapses to one tooth pitch; omit it to force the full range.
For a prismatic driver, 'ratio' is millimetres per unit of the sweep parameter, so range_deg [0, 100] with ratio 0.5 travels 50 mm.
